text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I let a rule-breaker get away! I
can't believe
I did that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Inari, you gotta give me a good
tongue-lashing!
Otherwise, I'll always be
a worthless
good-for-nothing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! Quit bein' a blockhead.
You want
me to set you straight? No way
I can do that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Take a good look at yourself! You do a
kick-ass
job—straight as an arrow.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You never turned your back from the
righteous
path, so what's there to be
ashamed of?! Now
stand up tall and walk
with some pride, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get it? There's always next time! Just be
prepared
and get it right with the next
one!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, you never let me down! You got
a heart of
gold! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I couldn't ask for anyone
better! Now lay
it on me! Give me a
good scolding!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Uhh... Did ya listen to a single word I said?
